h1: Rosemary Beach "Heaven on 7" 67 Dunmore Town Lane Main House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located south of 30A- Short walk to the community pool and beach access- Access to 4 neighborhood pools- Access to fitness center and racquet club- 2 vehicle parking- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Clean, white shiplap walls, 4 covered porches, and neutral tones create a relaxed, luxurious feel at the Heaven on 7 Main House in Rosemary Beach. This unforgettable 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom home sleeps 13 and is close to the beach and pool access, south of 30A.A porch swing bed and cozy Adirondack chairs greet guests on a covered porch that overlooks an enclosed landscaped courtyard with an outdoor dining table. Guests step inside to an open concept living, dining, and kitchen space filled with natural light. Premium appliances and an expansive kitchen island that seats 4 overlooks built-in cabinetry with a flat-screen TV and cozy sofas and chairs. A dining table seats 8 and enjoys views of a second covered porch with rocking chairs and an outdoor shower. A guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom with a shower/tub combo is past the kitchen.On the second floor, a living room with a queen sleeper sofa and a small writing desk provides guests with another space to gather and relax in. A primary bedroom has a king bed, private bathroom with shower, and a personal balcony with wooded views. A bright and cheery guest bedroom has 2 full beds and a private bathroom with shower. A bunk bedroom gives guests the choice of a twin-over-full bunk bed and a private bathroom with a shower. A second balcony offers guests views of the courtyard from a wrap-around outdoor couch.Guests will love exploring the shops, cobble-stone streets, and restaurants of Rosemary Beach on 4 included adult bikes. Book the Heaven on 7 Main House today.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyBunk Bedroom: Twin-over-Full Bunkbed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyLiving Area: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home.
